If you only look at three

These show the patterns companies are building with generative AI today. Open the architecture to see exactly what was wired together.

An HR agent that takes action

Answers policy questions from a knowledge base, then files leave and benefits requests through Lambda tools exposed over MCP. Records verified in DynamoDB.

Retrieval over real documents

Sales reports go into S3, get embedded with Titan, and are indexed in OpenSearch Serverless. Nova Lite answers questions from them.

AI that follows the rules

Guardrails block investment advice, redact personal data and filter content before any answer reaches the user.
